svg.title: Window cleaner — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as window cleaner, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A four-pane window is paired with a separate T-shaped window squeegee. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: long hair, a tapered face.
